verification.precondition: An initialized production surveyctl run has no open Assignment and an ambient SURVEYCTL_FORMAT value is present.
verification.stimulus: Invoke next without a format option, repeat with literal --format=text, opt in with literal --format=json, and attempt the undeclared --json alias.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Omitted format deterministically means text, text emits the exact persisted pending bytes, JSON is selected only by --format=json, and --json is rejected.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal assertion: surveyctl defaults deterministically to exact text and requires literal format json opt-in
verification.forbiddenMutation: Output selection must not infer from ambient state, reinterpret a --json alias, regenerate a repeated Assignment, or alter pending bytes.

behavior: surveyctl defaults deterministically to exact text and requires literal format json opt-in
